name: HH breakout 20 — failed-breakout reversal with ATR stop (30m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same failed-break trap (a reclaim after a failed downside break = trapped shorts covering) but on a 30m clock and — the distinct upgrade — with an ATR-MULTIPLE stop (exit.atr_mult) placed by current volatility rather than a fixed fraction, which matters for a reversal trade whose invalidation is 'price makes a NEW low beyond the failed break': the ATR stop sits just past the wick in vol terms, so it is tight in calm regimes and gives room in noisy ones, keeping per-trade risk constant. Detect range_position cross_up through a reclaim level with adx low (no trend). The 30m clock trades fewer, cleaner traps than 5m/15m so fees bite less. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the ATR-multiple stop does not beat the fixed-fraction stop on this reversal (the vol-scaling adds nothing), OR if the reclaim sequence has no edge over being at the low (the trap is decorative), OR if the reversion has moved intra-bar in the 2025 holdout so the 30m close entry misses it, OR if it survives only on illiquid alts with fictional fills.
catalyst: range reclaim after a failed downside break, ATR-sized risk
